about_the_game:
Unleash Your Inner Scientist in the Ultimate Fish Mutation Lab! 🐟👨‍🔬👩‍🔬

Take your Aquarist experience to the next level with this groundbreaking DLC! Step into a state-of-the-art laboratory where you can experiment with genetic modification to create brand-new species of fish 🐠🌐

This DLC allows players to discover new fish species through genetic experiments and laboratory research ⚗️. Players will combine specific fish species, ensure their well-being, and then conduct a series of tests collecting samples, adding reagents, using a centrifuge, and analyzing DNA in a mini-game to create brand-new species.  🔝🎣

The gameplay takes place in a brand-new laboratory location, where players can set up water systems and research environments for their experiments 💉☣️. As they progress, they will unlock new technologies that enhance gameplay in other locations and provide access to new items.

🔬 How It Works:

  • Introduce two compatible fish species into an aquarium and ensure their happiness 🌝

  • Conduct genetic research and wait a few in-game hours for results ⏲️

  • Extract a sample, add the right reagent, use the centrifuge, and analyze DNA in a fun minigame 🔄

  • Witness the birth of a brand-new, never-before-seen fish species! 🕵

🐠  DLC Features:

✅  Discover up to 20 crazy new fish species.


✅  Explore a brand-new laboratory location dedicated to genetic research.


✅  Manage your own lab by building water systems and maintaining research environments.


✅  Utilize realistic lab equipment to conduct groundbreaking studies.


✅  Unlock new technologies that enhance gameplay across all locations and introduce new items.

Are you ready to push the boundaries of science and redefine the underwater world? Dive in now and start experimenting! 📶
